claims.text: The network uses mean square error as the loss function for classification, which led to better results than binary cross entropy.
RMSprop is employed for parameter optimization during training.
The performance of the network is evaluated using F-measure as a metric.
The network's output probabilities are derived from applying softmax to the classification values.
